segments.name: Middle-market lending
segments.description: Invests in senior secured and one stop loans to U.S. middle-market companies, mostly sponsored by private equity firms.
segments.evidence: Segment Reporting ("ASC Topic 280"), the Company has determined that it has a single operating and reporting segment.

revenueModel.text: U.S. middle-market borrowers pay the company interest and fees on the senior secured and one stop loans it makes.
revenueModel.evidence: Our investment objective is to generate current income and capital appreciation by investing primarily in senior secured and one stop loans of U.S. middle-market companies.
